supersedes: v4b ASAP train complete; Nangate train stopped at explicit IO pin capacity; all retained, no model/test evaluated
data_role: new registered microbenchmarks and synthetic operation mixtures; formal/holdout PPA excluded

train.topology: one through four products, serial reduction and independent addends

validation.topology: two through four products with per-branch addends before reduction

test.topology: two through four products with unequal branch depths and balanced reduction

observer: parity output per sample after all kept capture banks; Q-D labels stop before capture; functional tests inspect every internal captured bit; observation logic excluded from core/scoped state area and separately retained as unassigned overhead
source_group: whole source bundle and every mapping/SDC variant; each split has distinct primitive widths and combination topology
fit: nonnegative base scale/intercept/operation-count/result-bit terms, delay and area separately; train only; maximum validation underprediction ratio times 1.05; no independent-test labels used
feasibility_budget_definition: multiples of measured Q-D label for classification evaluation only; never predictor input
support: bounded unsigned Mul/Add/AddCarry single-output DAGs; independent primary inputs; no masks/literals/correlated inputs, wide division or FP; out-of-domain stage composition rejected
boundary: H=T-QD-slack includes clkQ/setup/skew/uncertainty once; capture control path and engineering reserve separate
